paper_metadata.title: Black-Litterman Portfolio Optimization with Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum Computers

experiments.description: Quantum machine learning experiment to predict investor views for the Black-Litterman model using QSVM with a simple embedding feature map and no entanglement, evaluated on 12 S&P500 stocks over 9 walk-forward time segments.

algorithm.variant: QSVM with simple embedding feature map

feature_preprocessing: backward moving average with 3-week rolling window

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Classical financial indicator features are encoded into a quantum feature map UΦ(x); QSVM uses the kernel UΦ(x)†UΦ(x) and measures |0...0> probability.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary classification of future return trend labels for investor views; predict Y1 and Y2 from financial indicators.

problem_instance.description: Predict investor views for each asset in a 12-stock portfolio using weekly financial indicators and future 52-week log returns.
problem_instance.dataset_name: Yahoo Finance weekly stock data + FRED macro/financial indicators

preprocessing: remove feature vectors that are too close in feature space but have different labels

classical_preprocessing: same feature preprocessing as quantum model
classical_postprocessing: use predicted labels to construct η and investor view vector Q

experiments.description: Quantum machine learning experiment to predict investor views using a QNN classifier on the same 12-stock portfolio and walk-forward setup.

algorithm.ansatz: parameterized rotation ansatz with fully connected CNOT gates

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Classical features are encoded via a quantum feature map, followed by a trainable ansatz; outputs are measured in the computational basis and mapped by parity.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Binary classification of future return trend labels for investor views.

experiments.description: Hybrid Black-Litterman portfolio optimization experiment on 12 assets using QSVM-predicted investor views and heuristic VQE to solve the QUBO/Ising portfolio selection problem.

algorithm.variant: heuristic VQE for QUBO portfolio optimization
algorithm.ansatz: general rotation ansatz U(RY(θ), RZ(φ), RY(λ)) with linear entanglement
algorithm.convergence_criteria: optimizer convergence; then fixed parameters used for final sampling

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary portfolio vector x in {0,1}^N with one qubit per asset; mapped to Ising via x = (1 - Z)/2.
problem_formulation.objective_function: minimize γ/2 x^T Σ x - μ_BL^T x + λ(1^T x - B)^2
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: budget constraint enforced by quadratic penalty term with λ = 1.0
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: H = Σ_{i} Σ_{j>i} h_ij Z_i Z_j + Σ_i h_i Z_i + C

walk-forward backtest with 260-week training and 52-week testing

renormalize selected portfolio weights to sum to 1

problem_formulation.constraints_handling: budget constraint enforced by quadratic penalty term
